headline: Massive fire destroys six hotels in Zanzibar popular Nungwi Beach area forcing tourist evacuations
label: NEWS
caption:
A massive fire completely destroyed six hotels in Zanzibar and forced tourists to evacuate.

According to AP News and Sky News, an investigation is currently under way into the blaze that engulfed six hotels along Nungwi Beach.

Authorities and emergency services responded to the incident at the popular tourist destination.

No official reports on casualties have been detailed yet as investigations continue.
